title: Moria
tagline: Go down into the mines of Moria and face the Balrog.
summary: Moria is a roguelike from 1983 inspired by The Lord of the Rings. Create a character, buy equipment in the town, then descend level after level of a dungeon full of monsters and treasure, down to the Balrog at the bottom.
Robert Alan Koeneke wrote it in VMS Pascal at the University of Oklahoma. Its C version, Umoria, is still maintained.
This port follows Umoria 5.7.15. Your character is saved on the server, and the score list is shared by everyone who plays here.

controls.action: Move or attack in that direction (5 stays); with Shift the arrows run (the original's . and a direction)
The original's commands: ? lists them (i inventory, w wear, q quaff, r read, m cast, p pray, < > stairs, ...)
Save the character and leave (the next Play restores it)
Earlier messages, redraw the screen, quit the character (Ctrl+W and other keys the browser keeps: type ^ and the letter)
Leave a prompt or a list, go on after -more-, end a line
Options, among them the roguelike keys (h j k l y u b n to move, the arrows follow)
